map.选择物探方法，输入相应参数计算重力/磁法/电法/地震波异常值: Choose a geophysical method and enter the corresponding parameters to compute gravity/magnetic/electrical/seismic anomaly values.
map.💡 重力布格板：Δg = 0.0419 × ρ × h (mGal)，ρ 为密度: 💡 Gravity Bouguer slab: Δg = 0.0419 × ρ × h (mGal), ρ the density contrast (g/cm³), h the thickness (m).
map.重力布格板公式适用于水平层状介质近似: The gravity Bouguer slab formula applies to a horizontal layered-medium approximation
map.磁法球体公式为正上方极值，实际需考虑磁化方向: The magnetic sphere formula gives the maximum directly above; the magnetisation direction must be considered in practice
map.电法视电阻率基于均匀半空间假设: The apparent resistivity is based on a homogeneous half-space assumption
map.地震波速度=距离/时间，反射深度=v×t/2: Seismic velocity = distance/time, reflection depth = v×t/2
map.📚 深度解析：地球物理勘探正演数据计算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Forward Modelling Data Calculation in Geophysical Exploration
map.重力异常估算：由剩余密度差与厚度算布格/剩余重力异常: Gravity anomaly estimate: compute the Bouguer/residual gravity anomaly from the residual density contrast and thickness
map.磁法正演：由磁化率、磁化场、体积、埋深算磁异常 ΔT: Magnetic forward modelling: compute the magnetic anomaly ΔT from susceptibility, magnetising field, volume and depth
map.与地震波速、反射深度: and seismic velocity and reflection depth
Algorithm (four methods optional): gravity Δg=0.0419·Δρ·h (mGal, ×10 to get g.u.); magnetic ΔT=200·κ·H·V/z³ (nT), with magnetisation M=κ·H; electrical array factor K=2πa, apparent resistivity ρa=K·ΔV/I; seismic velocity v=d/t, reflection depth H=v·t/2. Each method forward-models in real time from the chosen parameters for comparison with the measured curve.
map.例（重力）：剩余密度差 Δρ=0.3g/cm³、厚度 h=100m → Δg=0: Example (gravity): residual density contrast Δρ=0.3 g/cm³, thickness h=100 m → Δg=0.0419×0.3×100=1.257 mGal (=12.57 g.u.). Example (electrical): electrode spacing a=10 m, potential difference ΔV=0.05 V, current I=1 A → K=2π×10=62.83 m, ρa=62.83×0.05/1=3.14 Ω·m, a low-resistivity layer characteristic.
map.正演和实测对不上怎么办？: What if the forward model does not match the measurements?
map.正演是理想模型（均匀板状体/点源），实测受围岩、地形与噪声影响。先检查参数（密度: Forward modelling uses an ideal model (uniform slab/point source), while measurements are affected by the host rock, topography and noise. First check whether the parameters (density contrast, depth, array) are reasonable, then perform inversion or 2D forward modelling; a single-point formula can only check the order of magnitude.
map.g.u. 和 mGal 怎么换？: How do g.u. and mGal convert?
map.1 g.u.（重力单位）=0.1 mGal，工具已自动换算（Δg×10）。国内物: 1 g.u. (gravity unit) = 0.1 mGal; the tool converts automatically (Δg×10). Domestic geophysical reports often use g.u. and international literature mostly uses mGal; the two differ only by a factor of 10.
map.集成重力、磁法、电法、地震波四种常用物探方法的异常值计算工具，按方法切换输入参数: An anomaly-value calculation tool integrating four common geophysical methods — gravity, magnetic, electrical and seismic — switching input parameters by method and using the Bouguer slab, magnetic sphere, Wenner apparent resistivity and velocity/reflection-depth formulas respectively.
